device.cpu_reference: libjpeg-turbo is not available on iOS: the CPU comparison is ImageIO (Apple's codec); exactness is checked against SHA-256 hashes of libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 output

conditions.clock: clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); failed calls are counted, not timed, and make a case invalid
conditions.gpu_warmup: 1.0 s of the same work before each timed case, then 15 timed calls (7 for files above 20 MP), median; no discarded iterations
conditions.imageio: kCGImageSourceUseHardwareAcceleration true (public-bench's imageio); identity against libjpeg-turbo's pixels
conditions.not_measured: libjpeg-turbo (not on iOS), ImageIO with the key false, VideoToolbox, Metal and libjpeg-turbo throughput, ImageIO encode
conditions.reference_decode: TurboRef tr_decode: libjpeg-turbo's libjpeg API, JDCT_ISLOW, do_fancy_upsampling TRUE, JCS_RGB (as public-bench)
conditions.reference_encode: TurboRef tr_encode: libjpeg API, quality 95, the file's sampling factors, JDCT_ISLOW, standard Huffman tables (as public-bench)
conditions.thermal_pause: before each file, while the thermal state is serious or critical, 15 s pauses (up to 10 minutes)
